Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.

728-1765-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
728-1765-5972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2738-2921-4871-6255.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

282-1362-1479.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Delina (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Synth Infiltrator each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1792-2539-3400-4762-6306.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid has an Aura attached to it.
1792-2539-3400-4762-6306.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers. Choose not to copy Retraction Helix
Resolve Retraction Helix
Cast Strong Back by paying {2}{G}, targeting Devoted Druid.
Ivy triggers, copying Strong Back twice due to Twinning Staff. Choose to have one copy target Ivy and the other copy target Devoted Druid.
Resolve all three Strong Backs, attaching one to Ivy and two to Devoted Druid.
Activate Devoted Druid using the ability given to it by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning the nontoken Strong Back from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 two additional times, then repeat step 8 one additional time.
Repeat from step 4.
1792-2539-3400-4762-6306.notes: You can start the combo without Devoted Druid having an Aura attached to it if you provide an additional {2} to start. If you do this, during step 10, only repeat the steps as able until Devoted Druid has toughness equal to 1 and is untapped. Then move to step 11.

If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.

Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

654-774-4543.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}.

When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.

2842-4681-5170-5231.description:

When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Move to your next durn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.

2067-2542-3509.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand that can target a single creature.
Your life total is equal to or greater than ten times the number of opponents you have, minus two, and minus an additional one for each poison counter your opponents have.
2067-2542-3509.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.

Resolve the Mirrorwing Dragon trigger, copying the spell for each other creature you control, with each copy targeting a different creature.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each copy made this way.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten poison counters, they lose the game.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining trigger.

When the token Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou and up to one additional target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
